records.context: For ``subcell_rbg`` and ``subcell_ybg``, choose :data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT` and give at least three distinct ``channels``: the two reference image layers in the model's order (microtubules then DNA, or ER then DNA), then one or more protein image layers. Each protein image layer is encoded in its own pass with the two references, and the passes' 1,536 dimensions are joined in image data channel order. With ``normalize=False`` each pass is min-max scaled as a whole, as the authors' loader does; with ``normalize=True`` the fixed ``channel_scale`` is used instead, so intensity stays comparable between extracted image regions. ``checkpoint_path`` may name a local copy of the weights; a file whose SHA-256 differs from the pinned digest, or from ``checkpoint_sha256`` when none is pinned, is refused.

With ``normalize=False`` each pass is min-max scaled as a whole, as the authors' loader does; with ``normalize=True`` the fixed ``channel_scale`` is used instead, so intensity stays comparable between crops. ``checkpoint_path`` may name a local copy of the weights; a file whose SHA-256 differs from the pinned digest, or from ``checkpoint_sha256`` when none is pinned, is refused.
records.translation: Fyrir ``subcell_rbg`` og ``subcell_ybg`` skaltu velja :data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT` og gefa að minnsta kosti þrjár ólíkar ``channels``: viðmiðunarmyndlögin tvö í röð líkansins (örpíplur og svo DNA, eða ER og svo DNA), síðan eitt eða fleiri próteinmyndlög. Hvert próteinmyndlag er kóðað í eigin umferð með viðmiðunarmyndlögunum tveimur, og 1536 víddir hverrar umferðar eru tengdar saman í röð rásanna. Með ``normalize=False`` er hver umferð lágmarks-hámarks-kvörðuð í heild, eins og hleðsluforrit höfundanna gerir; með ``normalize=True`` er föst ``channel_scale`` notuð í staðinn, svo styrkur haldist sambærilegur milli úrklippa. ``checkpoint_path`` getur vísað á staðbundið afrit af vigtunum; skrá sem hefur SHA-256 sem víkur frá festa tætigildinu, eða frá ``checkpoint_sha256`` þegar ekkert er fest, er hafnað.
